tags.name: inventory
tags.description: Inventory balances (read) and management write operations: receive, adjust, transfer.

get.summary: List the caller's own selectable active tenants.
get.description: Identity-scoped bootstrap. Requires only a valid session (no X-Tenant-Id) and returns solely the verified caller's own active memberships against active tenants.

200.description: The caller's active memberships and selectable tenants.

get.summary: Read the caller's effective read capability for a tenant.
List products in the caller's catalog read scope.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant brand.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.summary: List inventory balances in the caller's inventory read scope.

parameters.name: inventoryLocationId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant inventory location.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

post.summary: Receive stock into an inventory location.
post.description: Records received stock at a single in-tenant inventory location. Requires the inventory.receive permission over the target location and a required Idempotency-Key header; a replay with the same key and body is not applied twice, and the same key with a different body is a 409.

200.description: The recorded receipt and observed post-commit balance.

post.summary: Reconcile an inventory count to a physically observed on-hand.
post.description: Reconciles the balance at a single in-tenant inventory location to a counted on-hand, guarded by the version it was counted against (optimistic concurrency). Requires the inventory.adjust permission over the target location and a required Idempotency-Key header. A stale expectedVersion is a 409; a same-key/different-body replay is a 409.

200.description: The authoritative before/after balance for the reconciliation.

post.summary: Transfer stock between two inventory locations.
post.description: Atomically moves stock from a source to a destination inventory location. Requires the inventory.transfer permission over BOTH the source and the destination location and a required Idempotency-Key header. Insufficient source stock is a 409; a same-key/different-body replay is a 409.

200.description: The recorded transfer and observed post-commit balances of both sides.

get.summary: List orders in the caller's orders read scope.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant brand.

parameters.name: branchId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant branch.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.summary: Read a single order's detail and fulfillment progress.

200.description: The order detail with embedded fulfillment progress.

clerkSessionToken.description: Clerk session token presented as a Bearer credential.

TenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantIdHeader.description: The tenant the request operates within.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Caller-stable idempotency key for the write. A replay with the same key and body is not applied twice; the same key with a different body is rejected with a 409.

Error409.description: The request conflicts with current state.
